title: C: Doubly Linked List
description: Implement a doubly linked list with insert at end, delete, and reverse traversal.

steps.title: Doubly Linked List Operations
steps.description: Define a `DNode` struct with int data, prev, next pointers. Write `void insert_end(DNode **head, int val)`, `void delete(DNode **head, int val)`, and `void print_reverse(DNode *head)`. Test by inserting 10, 20, 30, then print reverse.
hints: Each node has prev and next pointers.
insert_end: find tail, link new node.
print_reverse: traverse to tail, then walk backwards.
